크리스킹(Chris King Precision Components)은 1: Chris King Precision Components was founded by Chris King in California in 1976. Frustrated by headsets that quickly loosened and rusted, the young machinist cut his own headset with sealed bearings. That headset was Chris King's first product.
그로부터 50년. 크리스킹은 지금도 헤드셋과 허브, 바텀브래킷을 오리건: Fifty years on, Chris King still makes its headsets, hubs and bottom brackets in its own factory in Portland, Oregon. Machining, bearing production, anodizing, assembly and inspection all happen under one roof. Parts you use for years, service, and move to your next bike. That is what Chris King considers a good part.
캘리포니아에서 시작된 독립 브랜드: An independent brand born in California
오리건 포틀랜드의 자체 공장에서 생산: Made in our own factory in Portland, Oregon

Built to last.
Made to be serviced.
크리스킹의 부품은 처음부터 정비를 전제로 설계됩니다. 베어링은 분해해서: Chris King parts are designed for service from the start. Bearings can be taken apart, cleaned and regreased, and wear parts are available separately. That is why Chris King headsets and hubs often outlast the frames they were fitted to. Repairing instead of replacing is the most basic way Chris King practises sustainability.
공장에서는 절삭 과정에서 나오는 알루미늄 칩을 재활용하고, 생산 전 과정: The factory recycles the aluminium chips from machining and keeps the whole production process in one place, so quality and environmental impact are managed directly. This approach, started in a small Portland factory, is now why riders and frame builders around the world choose Chris King.
바 스톡 알루미늄과 스테인리스를 포틀랜드 공장의 CNC 설비에서 직접 깎: Bar stock aluminium and stainless steel are machined on CNC equipment in our Portland factory.
부품의 수명을 결정하는 베어링을 직접 만듭니다. 크리스킹이 긴 보증을 약: We make the bearings that decide how long a part lasts. It is why Chris King can offer such long warranties.
사내 아노다이징 라인에서 입히는 컬러는 헤드셋, 허브, 비비 사이에서 같: Colours from our in-house anodizing line match across headsets, hubs and bottom brackets.
모든 부품은 숙련된 직원의 손으로 조립되고, 출고 전 하나씩 검사를 거칩: Every part is assembled by hand by skilled staff and inspected one by one before it ships.

헤드셋은 자전거에서 가장 눈에 띄지 않지만, 가장 먼저 망가지는 부품 중: The headset is the least visible part of a bike, yet one of the first to fail. Rain, sweat and every impact from the road go straight into it. Chris King started with exactly this problem. In-house sealed bearings, precisely machined cups and seals that keep dirt out preserve the same steering feel after tens of thousands of kilometres.
노스레드셋(NoThreadSet)의 그립락(GripLock) 구조는 스티: The GripLock design of the NoThreadSet centres the steerer precisely and holds it without play. Choose the InSet for tapered head tubes and the DropSet for integrated frames. Every Chris King headset comes with a 10-year warranty.
외장 컵 방식의 스레드리스 헤드셋. 수십 년 동안 프레임 빌더들이 가장: External-cup threadless headset. For decades the Chris King model frame builders have chosen most. GripLock centres the steerer precisely.
컵이 헤드튜브 안쪽으로 들어가는 반내장형 헤드셋. 테이퍼드 스티어러를 쓰: Semi-integrated headset with cups that sit inside the head tube. Fits many road, gravel and mountain frames with tapered steerers.
베어링을 프레임에 바로 앉히는 인티그럴 헤드셋. 앵귤러 콘택트 베어링으로: Integrated headset with bearings seated directly in the frame. Angular-contact bearings bring Chris King's smooth steering to carbon frames.
로드, 그래블, 산악, 투어링, 커스텀 프레임: Road, gravel, mountain, touring, custom frames

허브 역시 자체 제작 베어링을 쓰고, 프리로드를 조절하고 분해 정비할 수: The hubs also use in-house bearings and are designed for adjustable preload and full service. That is why many riders keep the same hubs through several wheel rebuilds.
두 개의 링이 넓은 면으로 맞물리는 크리스킹 고유의 드라이브 구조. 순간: Chris King's own drive system, with two rings engaging across a wide face. It spreads even sudden torque evenly and lasts.
헤드셋과 같은 철학으로 직접 만드는 베어링. 정밀한 공차와 실링이 매끄러: Bearings made in-house with the same philosophy as our headsets. Precise tolerances and sealing keep them turning smoothly for years.
전용 공구로 분해해 세척하고 다시 조립할 수 있습니다. 프리로드 조절로: Take it apart with dedicated tools, clean it and put it back together. Adjustable preload keeps the bearings running at their best.
QR과 스루액슬, 부스트 규격, 시마노 · 스램 프리허브 바디까지. 지금: QR, thru-axle and Boost, with Shimano and SRAM freehub bodies. For the bike you ride now and the next one.
가볍고 조용한 로드 허브. 45포인트 링드라이브로 로드와 그래블에 알맞은: A light, quiet road hub. 45-point RingDrive gives engagement suited to road and gravel. The R45D is the disc brake version.

BSA 나사산 프레임에 쓰는 스레드핏은 24mm 스핀들의 시마노 크랭크용: ThreadFit for BSA threaded frames comes as ThreadFit 24 for 24mm-spindle Shimano cranks and ThreadFit 30 for 30mm-spindle cranks. Precisely machined cups keep the bearings in exact alignment.

오래가는 헤드셋 하나를 만들겠다는 생각으로 1976년에 시작한 크리스킹은: Chris King began in 1976 with the idea of making one headset that would last, and still makes parts with the same idea. Instead of making them cheaper and faster, it has spent 50 years machining, assembling and standing behind its own parts.
캘리포니아의 젊은 기계공 크리스 킹이 자전거 부품을 직접 만들기 시작합니: Chris King, a young machinist in California, starts making his own bicycle parts.
실드 베어링을 넣은 헤드셋을 선보입니다. 크리스킹의 첫 제품이자 지금까지: Introduces a headset with sealed bearings. Chris King's first product, and still its signature.
헤드셋의 철학을 허브로 넓힙니다. 링드라이브는 크리스킹 허브의 상징이 됩: The headset philosophy extends to hubs. RingDrive becomes the symbol of Chris King hubs.
오리건 포틀랜드로 공장을 옮깁니다. 가공부터 아노다이징, 조립까지 한곳에: The factory moves to Portland, Oregon. Machining, anodizing and assembly all happen in one place.

즉각적인 72포인트 링드라이브. 산악과 그래블, 바이크패킹을 위한 크리스: Instant 72-point RingDrive. Chris King's mountain hub for trail, gravel and bikepacking.
BSA와 T47 나사산 프레임을 위한 바텀브래킷. 24mm, 30mm 스: Bottom brackets for BSA and T47 threaded frames. For 24mm and 30mm spindles.
크리스킹 허브의 심장은 링드라이브(RingDrive)입니다. 일반적인 폴: The heart of every Chris King hub is RingDrive. Instead of conventional pawls, two wide toothed rings engage across their full face, spreading the load evenly and transferring power the moment you push the pedal. 45 points of engagement on the R45, 72 on the Boost and Superboost mountain hubs. It is also where the famous Chris King buzz comes from.
부스트 규격의 산악 허브. 72포인트 링드라이브의 빠른 맞물림으로 트레일: Boost-standard mountain hub. Fast engagement from a 72-point RingDrive for trail, gravel and bikepacking. Available with 6-bolt or Centerlock disc mounts.
슈퍼부스트 규격 프레임을 위한 리어 허브. 72포인트 링드라이브와 넓은: Rear hub for Superboost frames. 72-point RingDrive and wide flange spacing build a stiff wheel for rough trail and enduro terrain.
The bottom bracket is where a rider's power passes first and hardest. Chris King bottom brackets use the same in-house bearings as our headsets and hubs, turning quietly here for years. Choose ThreadFit 24 or 30 for BSA threaded frames and ThreadFit T47 for T47 frames.
BSA 나사산 프레임을 위한 선택: The choice for BSA threaded frames
T47 프레임도 나사산으로, 조용하게: Threaded and quiet, even on T47
T47은 큰 지름의 셸에 나사산을 낸 규격으로, 압입식의 잡음 없이 넓은: T47 is a threaded standard with a large-diameter shell, giving the room of a wide shell without the creaks of press-fit, and is now common on road and gravel frames. Chris King ThreadFit T47 comes in external (x), internal (i) and asymmetric (A) versions with 24mm or 30mm spindle options to suit your frame and crank.
